name: dev-ops
label: Dev Ops
summary: Infrastructure automation, CI/CD, macOS and iOS release packaging, signing, distribution, and runtime operations for Situate.
useWhen: Change deployment definitions, environment provisioning, CI/CD workflows, or operational configuration.
Work on macOS or iOS packaging, signing, notarization, release publication, or recovery.
Document implemented deployment topology, infrastructure decisions, or operational risks.
avoidWhen: The primary task changes application business logic, user experience, or application-owned data formats.
Product strategy or a consequential architecture decision must be resolved before operational implementation.
A manual server patch should instead be captured in reproducible provisioning.
